integrity: The structural two-colour component identity and qualitative expected-value convergence are prior work. Asymptotic proof and new numerical verification are provided. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Complete graphs, two named colours, uniform equitable sampling, n tending to infinity; not a statement for non-equitable colouring or other graph families. No independent mathematical audit or definitive global bibliographic-priority determination.
title: Parity-sensitive rare-event law for wild edges in balanced two-colour complete graphs
